name: Recall and Reactivation
outcome: Help the clinic identify due follow-up or recall work and manage approved contact to support continuity of care.
required_inputs: Consent, contact preference and suppression information
guardrails: The clinic defines clinical recall timing.
Do not infer a treatment need or make clinical recommendations.
Apply opt-outs and communication rules before any contact.
Do not create duplicate patient records or appointment writes.
activation_requirements: A supported authorized practice-management data path.
Clinician-approved recall criteria and clinic-approved messages.
Deduplication, access controls, privacy review and staff handoff.
